senses.gloss: धुर् f. (nom. sing. धूः) 1. A yoke, अत्रस्नुभिर्युक्तधुरं तुरंगैः R.xiv.47; 2. that part of it which rests on the shoulder; 3. the pin at both ends of an axle for fastening the nave of the wheel; 4. the pole of a carriage; 5. a load, a burden (lit. and fig.), तेन धूर्जगतो गुर्वीं सचिवेषु निचिक्षिपे R.i.34, v.66, K.S.vi.30; 6. the highest place, the front, the top, अपांसुलानां धुरि कीर्तनीया R.ii.2, स्थेयाः पितेव धुरि पुत्रिणाम् i.91, धुरि स्थिता त्वं पतिदेवतानाम् xiv.74.
धूर्गत a. 1. standing on the pole of a chariot; 2. standing at the head, foremost.
धूर्जटि m. an epithet of Sira.
धूर्धर (I) a. 1. bearing the yoke; 2. fit to be harnessed; 3. laden with important duties; 4. chief, foremost, preeminent, e.g. धुरंधरः पुण्यकृदेष तापसः.
धूर्धर (I) a. 1. bearing the yoke; 2. fit to be harnessed; 3. laden with important duties; 4. chief, foremost, preeminent, e.g. धुरंधरः पुण्यकृदेष तापसः.
धुरंधर (II) m. 1. a beast of burden; 2. a man of business; 3. a chief, a leader.
धूर्वह (I) a. 1. carrying a burden; 2. managing affairs.
धूर्वह (II) m. a beast of burden.
धुरा f. A burden, a load.
धुरीण (f. णा) (I) a. 1. Able to bear a burden; 2. charged with important duties.
धुरीण (II) m. 1. A beast of burden; 2. a man of business; 3. a chief, a leader.
धुरीण (f. णा) (I) a. 1. Able to bear a burden; 2. charged with important duties.
धुर्य (I) a. (f. र्या) 1. Able to bear a burden; 2. able to discharge important duties; 3. standing at the head, foremost.

धुर्य (II) m. 1. A beast of burden; 2. a horse or bullock yoked to a carriage, अथ यंतारमादिश्य धुर्यान् विश्रामयेति सः R.i.54, M.iv.67, K.S.vi.76; 3. a leader, a chief, न हि सति कुलधुर्ये सूर्यवंश्या गृहाय R.vii.71; 4. one who carries a burden, R.v.66.
धुर्य (I) a. (f. र्या) 1. Able to bear a burden; 2. able to discharge important duties; 3. standing at the head, foremost.
धूर्त (I) a. (f. र्ता) 1. Cunning, crafty, fraudulent; 2. mischievous, injurious.
धूर्त (II) m. 1. A rogue, a swindler; 2. a gamester; 3. a lover, a gallant, a gay deceiver, धूर्तोऽपरां चुंबति Am.S.16, धूर्तानामभिसारसत्वरहृदाम् Git.G.xi.; 4. the thorn-apple (धत्तूर).
धूर्त (I) a. (f. र्ता) 1. Cunning, crafty, fraudulent; 2. mischievous, injurious.
धूर्त-कृत् m. the dhattūra plant.
धूर्त-जंतु m. a man.
धूर्तक m. A jackal.
धूर्वी f. The forepart or pole of a carriage.
धुरीय (f. या) (I) a. 1. Able to bear a burden; 2. charged with important duties.
धुरीय (II) m. 1. A beast of burden; 2. a man of business; 3. a chief, a leader.
धुरीय (f. या) (I) a. 1. Able to bear a burden; 2. charged with important duties.
